It is possible to link the ordering system with stock management, which allows the system to automatically analyze instances where items are below the minimum stock level and generate fully automatic order proposals. features.title: order management

By communicating with the CNC machine, »flash« regularly and fully automatically checks the current tool life and labels their status with colors. Tools that need to be replaced due to the end of their tool life can thus be picked, fitted, and preset in advance. This avoids quality losses, tool breakage, and machine downtime. intro: As a tool manufacturer or grinding shop, you must deliver the highest quality. The »genius« universal measuring machine provides you with exact measurement data that serves as irrefutable proof of the high production quality of your products.

1:1 expert meeting

sections.title: High-Precision Optics
text: With ZOLLER »genius«, you can measure virtually any aspect of a tool—precisely, fully automatic, and non-contact. No matter how complex the tool is.

sections.title: Guaranteed Accuracy
text: Quality management requirements are constantly increasing. That is why you need to be able to rely on the consistent measurement deviations of your machines. In ZOLLER measuring machines, length measurement deviations are determined using high-precision Calibration standards made of Borofloat glass® in accordance with the DIN EN ISO 10360 standard. In accordance with this standard, at least three measurement sequences (25,326 relationships) are performed. This procedure documents the two-dimensional accuracy of ZOLLER measuring machines and ensures traceability at all times.

sections.title: The Fact Check for Tools
text: A »genius« is simple to use and built to last. The Universal measuring machine is designed for long measuring operations in multi-shift production right on the production floor.
The ZOLLER Inspection & Measuring Solution proves what many claim: quality.

sections.title: Top Performance with Minimal Effort

products.name: »threadCheck«

products.headline: Measures the geometries of threading tools
intro: Where conventional measuring technology reaches its limits, ZOLLER’s »threadCheck« universal measuring machine really comes into its own.

Thanks to six CNC axes and the swivelling »orthoScan« multisensor optic carrier, you can not only measure all types of cutting tools with absolute precision and speed, but also measure pitched tools with μm-accuracy and without distortion.

products.name: »sawCheck«
products.headline: Precision in Saw Blade Measurement
intro: The manufacture and regrinding of precision saw blades are subject to ever-increasing requirements for accuracy and cost-effectiveness.

With the »sawCheck« inspection and measuring machine, ZOLLER offers a solution for measuring saw blades fully automatically, tooth by tooth, with high precision, and user-independent. During tooth inspection, parameters such as tooth profile, pitch, radial run-out, and cutting height can be measured using transmitted light. Using incident light, parameters such as rake angle, radial relief angle, tooth thickness, center offset, or wear and tear—whether radial or axial—can be quickly inspected and documented in detail, all user-independent and quickly.

products.name: »edgeControl 600«
products.claim: Determine the Wear Level and Save Money
products.headline: Determine the Wear Level and Save Money
intro: If tools are used for too long or exchanged too early, this can lead to higher costs. The ZOLLER »edgeControl 600« tool setting and measuring machine helps determine the wear level of tools.

In addition to precise tool presetting and measurement, the ZOLLER »edgeControl 600« presetting and measuring machine offers the additional option of recording high-definition color images of the tool’s chip clearance area, tool circumference, and tool face using its incident light camera.

products.name: »edgeControl«
products.claim: Detection of tool breakage on all cutting edges
products.headline: Detection of tool breakage on all cutting edges
intro: Do you want to deliver 100% quality to your customers and/or resharpen tools efficiently, and therefore need to quickly and precisely detect tears or wear and tear on tool cutting edges?

The ZOLLER »edgeControl« with a 3D sensor handles this demanding task for you. The sensor is aligned fully automatically with the cutting edge, and the cutting edges are digitized in 3D, including simultaneous axis path control. The subsequent analysis of the 3D model is also fully automated and can be manually adjusted if desired.

products.name: »3dCheck«
products.claim: Enters, digitizes, and analyzes complex tools
products.headline: Enters, digitizes, and analyzes complex tools
intro: ZOLLER »3dCheck« is the perfect inspection machine for fast, process-oriented 3D digitization.

It opens up new dimensions in tool measurement and is also versatile, accurate, and user-friendly. The ZOLLER »3dCheck« combines the advantages of the optical ZOLLER »Z3dCam« (3D sensor) with high-precision CNC axes and fully automatic transmitted light image processing.

products.name: »caz«
products.headline: The Virtual Measuring Machine
intro: ZOLLER »caz« (computer-aided ZOLLER) is a virtual presetting and measuring machine that allows you to define the measuring tasks for a ZOLLER presetting and measuring machine directly on a 3D model of the tool.
When designing your tool, you define at which locations and how the tool will be measured after completion. ZOLLER »caz« is a software module that you can use directly within your CAD design.

intro: Shrink and unshrink tools in record time while saving energy and protecting the tooling: You get all these benefits with the »powerShrink« inductive shrinking system. With the »powerShrink« series of devices, you can boost the efficiency of your production.

»actbyLight« guides you safely through the shrinking process and includes the »shrinkbyLight« coil function, the LED control on the induction coil, and the »coolbyLight« LED user guidance on the cooling system.

sections.title: Less Energy, Maximum Profit
text: With ZOLLER’s »powerShrink«, you save time, reduce your electricity costs, and extend the life of your shrink fit holders thanks to the perfect interplay of electronics, software, and mechanics, combined with a well-designed, reliable shrink process.

sections.title: Smart Design for Maximum Efficiency
text: A smart, well-designed highlight of the »powerShrink« is the ZOLLER induction coil. Two windings connected in parallel within the coil can be activated separately and controlled differently depending on the clamping diameter and length. This enables optimal energy transfer to the clamping area, accelerates the heating and cooling process, and protects your tool holders.

sections.title: Cool Features for Efficient Cooling
text: With »powerShrink« from ZOLLER, you can cool with maximum efficiency. The five cooling bells for standard-compliant shrink fit holders ranging from D6 mm to D32 mm ensure fast, consistent cooling thanks to their intelligent design and integrated contact cooling. Your shrink fit holders are protected, and their high concentricity is maintained.

sections.title: ZOLLER has fundamentally modernized the process of (to) shrink
text: A new era has begun in shrink technology. To achieve this, we haven’t just redesigned the key components of shrink machines. We’ve introduced a new generation of machines that far surpasses all other solutions.
Significant energy savings, heating with nearly 100% efficiency, extremely fast cooling, and intuitive user guidance—shrinking and unshrinking with ZOLLER redefines an established process.

features.title: 30% energy savings
features.text: ZOLLER induction technology allows you to heat your shrink fit holders optimally. For you, this means: consistent heating across the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This results in short heating and cooling times, short cycle times, reduced wear on the holders, and a longer lifetime. A particular advantage of »powerShrink«—through which ZOLLER contributes to sustainable manufacturing practices—is the energy savings of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We’re especially proud of this. The heat and energy are delivered exactly where you need them to safely shrink and unshrink your tools.

features.title: When Art Hits the Mark
features.text: Inspired by modern architecture and optical kinematics, ZOLLER’s Research and Development department has created a masterpiece. The ZOLLER induction coil with the »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrink-wrapping process. Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly constructed. The eight variable elements of the »varOct« coil shielding glide smoothly past one another—a design masterpiece. ZOLLER’s unique approach delivers unbeatable design and efficiency.

features.title: Flexibility in the blink of an eye
features.text: With the ZOLLER induction coil with shielding discs, you’re choosing a simple, manual shrink-fitting process for applications with infrequent diameter changes or low variation. Discs of different diameters ensure that the coil’s magnetic field is optimally aligned and shielded accordingly. The optionally available »shrinkbyLight« user guidance, consisting of a control LED for diameter monitoring and a status indicator for the windings, provides additional process reliability during the operation of your »powerShrink«.

features.title: Focused on comfort and safety
features.text: The right cooling bell for every requirement: Choose between the standard cooling bell or the cooling bell with »coolbyLight« user guidance for maximum safety for your operators. Both cooling bells are available with either free-moving or linear, mechanical guidance, depending on your preference.

features.title: Cooling Bell Guide
features.text: Simply hooked in or securely guided? Choose between two options for the cooling hood guide: the simple fixing mechanism or the linear guide for maximum comfort and safety.

features.title: The Unique Cooling Alternative
features.text: With the »zStream« air cooling by ZOLLER you get maximal flexibility and protection with the cooling of your tools and shrink fit tool holder, independently of their contour or diameter. Tool cutting edges are in absolutely no danger of being damaged. You require absolutely no accessories such as a cooling adapter. In addition, your shrink tools are cooled evenly along their entire length.

products.headline: We stand for smart progress
intro: With optimally and highly precisely balanced tools, you can achieve longer tool life, extended spindle runtime, and better surface finish on your components. With »toolBalancer«, you can bring not only your tools but your entire manufacturing process into perfect balance between sustainability, efficiency, and progress.

sections.title: Reach Your Destination with Safety and Quickness
text: »toolBalancer« makes tool balancing especially simple: thanks to the ergonomically designed »twinPanel« safety hood, a convenient membrane keypad, a compartment for balance adapters, and storage shelves in the spacious work area.

The ZOLLER operating software, with its structured graphic representation, intuitively guides the operator through the measurement and balancing process. Using the software options that correspond to balancing applications, all balancing applications on 1 to 2 balancing planes are available, such as fixed-point balancing with balancing screws, the use of balancing rings, or balancing through material removal such as drilling or milling.

sections.title: From the Center to the Highest Precision
text: An unbalance in tools results from an asymmetrical design and the associated asymmetrical mass distribution. The ZOLLER »toolBalancer« resolves the unbalance by using like to counter like and relies on a deliberate center offset in the balance adapter during measurement and balancing of your tools.

The center offset balance adapter is constructed with a two-point contact system and a pressure piece. These features produce a strong, more easily measurable sensor signal and guarantee highly precise balancing results, especially for high-quality balancing and small unbalances.

sections.title: Balancing Means Peace of Mind for Tools
text: If rotating tools are not running true, vibrations occur. Even at low speeds, these vibrations can lead to increased tool wear, reduced surface quality, and additional stress on the machine spindles. Therefore, have your tools balanced regularly on a ZOLLER balancing machine.
Learn more about the benefits of the ZOLLER Solution Balancing.

features.title: »twinPanel« Safety Cover
features.text: Corresponds to DIN ISO 21940-23 Class C60 for maximum safety. The internal “sacrificial pane” records contaminants such as residues of cooling lubricants and damage caused by component detachment. This takes into account the very important—and often overlooked—process of protective pane aging resulting from daily use. By allowing for quick and cost-effective exchange of the sacrificial pane, the ZOLLER »twinPanel« guarantees the long-term safety of your operators.

features.title: high-precision spindle
features.text: Accommodates virtually any tool holder with the appropriate balance adapter. Depending on the weight of the tool, the spindle rotates it at an adjustable speed ranging from 400 to a maximum of 1,200 revolutions per minute and measures the unbalance with an accuracy of < 0.4 gmm. In designing the high-precision spindle, ZOLLER placed especially great focus on a safe and certified adapter-changing process. A special design feature avoids accidents and damage caused by balance adapters that are not securely fastened in the spindle.
